_doc: Comprehensive infirm/non-firm connection risk taxonomy — beyond binary switch-off. Consumed by harness/enrich_infirm_risk.py, entity_analysis infirm_risk_profile[], analysis essay, key_risks generation. Literature: contract/knowledge/infirm-connection-risk-profile.md

predictability_classes.label: Capacity-limited
predictability_classes.notice: Static MW cap — predictable derating, not necessarily zero

predictability_classes.label: Time-limited
predictability_classes.notice: Scheduled windows — forecastable but still non-damage

predictability_classes.label: Dynamic operating envelope
predictability_classes.notice: Forecast horizon limits — partial availability with basis risk on index

predictability_classes.label: Fully flexible / ANM
predictability_classes.notice: Real-time dispatch — worst predictability; compute SLA tail

constraint_classes.label: Transmission / boundary
constraint_classes.loss_channel: Export or import limit at constraint boundary — revenue or SLA without damage

constraint_classes.label: Generation balance
constraint_classes.loss_channel: Balancing-authority curtailment when firm capacity accredited but generation scarce

constraint_classes.label: Distribution hosting
constraint_classes.loss_channel: DNO flexible connection or hosting-capacity intervention on feeder

dimensions.label: Full interruption
dimensions.question: How often does lawful curtailment drive availability to zero?
dimensions.loss_channel: Binary off — SLA breach, lost revenue, no physical damage
dimensions.insurance_gap: Physical-damage BI and standard PD do not respond

dimensions.label: Capacity derating
dimensions.question: Is the asset constrained below nameplate or contracted MW without a full outage?
dimensions.loss_channel: Partial MW cap — under-utilised capacity, stranded capex, blended PUE
dimensions.insurance_gap: Property limits on TIV, not on utilisation shortfall

dimensions.label: Compute & utilisation
dimensions.question: Does infirm grid service degrade workload throughput, inference latency, or batch SLAs?
dimensions.loss_channel: Deferred jobs, migration cost, customer penalties — service unreliability not equipment failure
dimensions.insurance_gap: Cyber outage covers stack/vendor; not grid-lawful curtailment

dimensions.label: Predictability & notice
dimensions.question: Can the operator or insurer forecast the event horizon?
dimensions.loss_channel: Unplanned curtailment → higher SLA penalty and hedging cost
dimensions.insurance_gap: Parametric index must match notice class or basis risk explodes

dimensions.label: Frequency × duration
dimensions.question: What is the compound loss E[N]·E[S] — not the single worst hour?
dimensions.loss_channel: Repeated partial events accumulate; tail is duration-heavy
dimensions.insurance_gap: Occurrence limits and waiting periods mis-size chronic curtailment

dimensions.label: Constraint mechanism
dimensions.question: Is loss from transmission limit, generation balance, or distribution hosting?
dimensions.loss_channel: Same MW cut, different trigger and mitigation (BESS, shift, accredited capacity)
dimensions.insurance_gap: Single weather index ≠ multi-mechanism grid stress

dimensions.label: Connection & COD stage
dimensions.question: Is risk pre-energisation, queue, or operational?
dimensions.loss_channel: Delay, cost overrun, lender draw — before first curtailment hour
dimensions.insurance_gap: CAR/DSU ≠ availability; tenor on tower vs queue uncertainty

dimensions.label: Basis & index mismatch
dimensions.question: Does the insured metric (SLA, revenue, GPU-hour) match the grid trigger?
dimensions.loss_channel: Payout–loss gap on parametric or proxy hedge
dimensions.insurance_gap: Weather parametric ≠ gate status; wind index ≠ NESO order

composite_formula.description: Weighted mean of dimension ratings (0–4), normalised to 0–1 infirm_severity_index
